name: Project Documentation Creator
description: An agent that creates project documentation including README files and API docs, and validates the output format for correctness and completeness.

readme-generation.description: Generates well-structured README files with standard sections like title, description, installation, usage, and license.

tests.description: Generated README contains all standard sections
tests.prompt: Create a README.md for a Node.js CLI tool called 'datapipe' that transforms CSV files into JSON. It uses Node 18+, is installed via npm, and is MIT licensed.

tests.description: Generated README includes code examples or code blocks
tests.prompt: Create a README.md for a Python library called 'fastquery' that provides a fluent API for SQL query building. Include installation and usage examples.

tests.description: Output is valid markdown with proper heading hierarchy
tests.prompt: Generate a README for a REST API service called 'auth-gateway' built with Go. It handles JWT authentication and rate limiting.

api-documentation.description: Generates API documentation describing endpoints, parameters, request/response formats, and error codes.

tests.description: API docs include endpoint paths and HTTP methods
tests.prompt: Create API documentation for a user management service with endpoints: POST /users (create user), GET /users/:id (get user), PUT /users/:id (update user), DELETE /users/:id (delete user). Each endpoint accepts and returns JSON.

tests.description: API docs include request and response format descriptions
tests.prompt: Document the API for a POST /orders endpoint that accepts a JSON body with fields: productId (string, required), quantity (integer, required), shippingAddress (string, optional). It returns 201 with the created order object or 400 on validation error.

tests.description: API docs describe error responses and status codes
tests.prompt: Create API documentation for a GET /products/:id endpoint that returns product details. Include error responses for not found, unauthorized, and server error scenarios.

format-validation.description: Validates that generated documentation follows proper formatting conventions and identifies issues in existing docs.

tests.description: Identifies missing required sections in a README
tests.prompt:
Validate this README and list what's missing:

# MyApp

A cool app.

## Usage

Run `myapp start`.

Review this API doc for formatting issues and suggest corrections:

# API
##GET /users
Returns users.
Parameters
name - filter by name
##POST /users
Creates user.
Body: {name, email}
Returns: 200

Note the missing spaces after ## and inconsistent structure.

tests.description: Does not claim empty or trivial documentation is complete
tests.prompt:
Is this README complete and ready for publishing?

# App

An app.

tool-usage.description: Uses file-write tools to save generated documentation to disk.

tests.description: Calls file-write tool to save README.md
tests.prompt: Create a README.md file for a project called 'taskrunner' - a task scheduling library for Python. Write it to disk at ./README.md.
Generate API reference documentation for a WebSocket chat service with connect, send-message, and disconnect events.
